cover.title: Elevating the stargazer's journey
cover.alt: Screenshot of the Unistellar mobile app showing a phone with an immersive view of Earth from space in the background. The interface features a connected telescope in the foreground, a section titled 'My Odyssey,' and information about battery and storage. The app is dedicated to astronomy and smart telescope management.

hero.title: Unistellar UX
hero.earthAlt: Satellite view of Earth at night, showing Europe with city lights illuminating the continent, clouds over the Atlantic Ocean, and part of Africa visible in the bottom left. The image captures the planet’s curvature and the atmosphere lit by the sun.
hero.screenHomeAlt: Screenshot of the Unistellar mobile app showing the eVscope telescope control interface. The screen displays the telescope name 'My Odyssey,' its battery level at 50%, a 'Watch' button to start observation, and a tutorial titled 'How to get a perfect focus with your eVscope telescope.' In the background, an image of the telescope pointed toward space with Earth in the distance.

contexte: In 2022, Unistellar, a leader in smart telescopes, underwent a full rebranding to solidify its market position.

principles.title: My design principles

items.title: Tangible
items.text: Turning abstract strategy into a concrete, human-centered product.

items.title: Emotion
items.text: Design that moves users is a powerful driver of success.

items.title: Empathy
items.text: Standing in the user's shoes fuels creativity.

items.title: Essential
items.text: Prioritizing the essential for a clear, effortless experience.

principles.closing: Unistellar is a tech-driven company above all: building trust in UX methods took consistency — and repeated results.

quote.text: At first, I was excited to start, but now I feel completely lost and don't know where to go next.

items.title: Talk like your users
items.text: Azimuth, RA/DEC, J2000: jargon that blocks more than it helps.

items.title: A guide, not a remote
items.text: Faced with a huge catalog, users got stuck with no suggestions.

items.title: A stagnant experience
items.text: Once triggered, nothing more happens — users become passive.

items.title: Actions with no payoff
items.text: Some actions added neither emotion nor perceived value.

steps.title: Design the right thing
steps.subtitle: Discover → Define
steps.text: Understand the problem before reaching for solutions.

steps.title: Design it right
steps.subtitle: Explore → Validate
steps.text: Test, measure, iterate until the solution holds.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.text: Our starting assumption — simplifying flows would be enough — turned out incomplete: reducing cognitive load and guiding users mattered just as much.

transformation.title: From frustration to satisfaction
transformation.text: Users loved the telescope but got stuck in the app. We turned that disappointment into satisfaction — not by changing the product, but how it was discovered.

results.title: Design that shows in the numbers

items.title: Communicate as much as you build
items.text: A feature nobody understands goes unused.

items.title: Make the useful visible
items.text: An invisible product loses its perceived value.

items.title: Set measurable goals
items.text: Without a benchmark, progress can't be tracked.
